top_choice_rationale: P001 (GLP-1 physiology and its active form: Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) is a mature, mechanistically complete and independently replicated discovery with large randomized outcome evidence in type 2 diabetes and obesity. The three-name allocation and citation scope are defensible, and all six members already converge on it, so no award would be a worse outcome than awarding it.
